import sys, json, os, subprocess
def release(rid, nkeys, mode):
    motifs=[[1515+20*k, 1516+20*k] for k in range(nkeys)]
    disc=[]
    for motif in motifs:
        for _ in range(2):
            disc.append({'class':0,'values':[0]*24+motif+[0]*24,'activation':[0]*24+[100,100]+[0]*24})
    return {'id':rid,'classes':1,'width':2,'eps':[1,1000],'ratio':[1,nkeys],'threshold':[0,1],
            'mode':mode,'packet_limit':200000,'idle_us':10**12,'discovery':disc,
            'train':[{'class':0,'values':[1515,1516]}],
            'validation':[{'class':0,'values':[m for motif in motifs for m in motif][:128]}]}
env = dict(os.environ, SYNECDOCHE_SITE='/workspace/site', LD_LIBRARY_PATH='/workspace/native', PYTHONPATH='/workspace/site')
def run(releases, blocks, cap):
    req={'capacity':cap,'releases':releases,'blocks':blocks}
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/run.py'],input=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode(),capture_output=True,env=env)
    return json.loads(p.stdout)

A=release('A',2,'range'); B=release('B',2,'range')
cap={'range':3,'exact':3}
out=run([A,B],[[['install','A'],['open','f'],['packet','f',0,0,100],['install','B'],['close','f']]],cap)
print('busy case:', [(i['at'],i['id'],i['status'],i['resident'],i['used']) for i in out['installs']], out['final'])
cap4={'range':4,'exact':4}
out=run([A,B],[[['install','A'],['open','f'],['packet','f',0,0,100],['install','B'],['close','f']]],cap4)
print('pin+evict:', [(i['at'],i['id'],i['status'],i['resident'],i['used']) for i in out['installs']], out['final'])
out=run([A,B],[[['install','A'],['open','f'],['packet','f',0,0,100],['install','B'],['install','A'],['close','f']]],cap4)
print('reinstall:', [(i['at'],i['id'],i['status'],i['resident'],i['used']) for i in out['installs']], out['final'])
out=run([A,B],[[['install','A'],['open','f'],['packet','f',0,0,100],['install','A'],['close','f']]],cap4)
print('self-reinstall:', [(i['at'],i['id'],i['status'],i['resident'],i['used']) for i in out['installs']], out['final'])
# classified epoch still pins

# epoch opened on A, classified, then install B ok (A pinned), more packets, close -> evict
